svg.title: 3F-tight — Transition-wall takeoff elbow with easy-bend elbow
svg.desc: Individual fitting. Removed inset outline from the main-duct end at lower-right; opening boundaries use single lines. Retained the fitting geometry and full-width original main duct upstream and downstream. Generic source artwork remains shared across corner variants; IDs and fitting values are distinct. High-resolution raster in SVG.
